answer.response_raw: To make crispy tofu sticks, preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Slice the tofu into 1 x 1 x 3 inch sticks. In a medium bowl, mix together flour, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. In another small bowl, beat the eggs. In a third bowl, place cornflakes. Lightly roll the tofu sticks in the seasoned flour, dip them in the beaten eggs, and then roll them in the cornflakes, ensuring all sides are coated. Place the coated tofu sticks on a baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees for approximately 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
